description: This file defines the 'Coocook::Model::Plan' class, which contains business logic for handling project and day plan data structures, including methods for retrieving meals, dishes, ingredients, and project details within a cooking or meal planning application.

classes.name: Coocook::Model::Plan
classes.description: A class encapsulating business logic for managing project/day plans, including retrieving meals, dishes, ingredients, and project details.

methods.name: day
methods.description: Retrieves the list of meals and associated dishes and ingredients for a specific project on a given date.

methods.name: project
methods.description: Retrieves a structured overview of all days and meals within a project, including associated dishes.

methods.name: project_for_meals_dishes_editor
methods.description: Provides a simplified structure of the project's meals suitable for editing purposes.

methods.name: resolve_meal_dish_path
methods.description: Resolves a path to a specific dish or meal within a project based on provided identifiers.
